name: player_team CPOE pools its components across the player's games rather than summing per-game means (executed-result parity)
description: A live wrong-number repair, pinned. Before the team family carried a measure, this column's season render was AVG(completion_percentage_over_expected) per (team, year, week) and the player variant's outer expression was `sum(<that>)` -- a SUM of per-GAME MEANS across every game the player was active for, so a full season read roughly seventeen times the true value. The seed makes the three candidate answers distinct: team ZZ throws two plays in week 1 at CPOE 10 and 20 and one play in week 2 at CPOE 60, so the pooled value is 90/3 = 30, the sum of per-game means is 15 + 60 = 75, and the mean of the per-game means is 37.5. Only the pooled answer is right, and it is the one the two-accumulator measure produces.
